motivation: Test a literature-backed aggregate trend-information family that is materially different from Trial 1 single-market candle forecasting and Trial 3's six-characteristic monthly ridge. The candidate is inspired by Fieberg et al. (2025) CTREND, but is adapted prospectively to TheOldTrader's historical liquidity universe, conservative retail costs, long-only exposure limits, and strict chronological firewall. It is not a rescue or modification of any observed trial.
dataSource: checksum-verified Binance Vision public spot daily archives

universe.rule: use exactly the immutable 30-symbol 2022-only liquidity universe formed under cross-sectional-v1; Trial 4 may not add, remove, replace, or rerank members using 2023-or-later information
universe.dependency: Trial 4 evaluation is blocked until Trial 3 universe formation has been completed and committed under its already-frozen 2022-only rule
universe.survivorshipRule: never begin from a current exchangeInfo/current-survivor list and never replace a delisted or missing member with a later survivor

historicalData.missingDataRule: an asset must have every daily bar required for the relevant indicator at a decision. Missing history makes that signal unavailable for that asset; an already-held asset that loses tradeable daily data before the next weekly rebalance is force-exited at its final observed close before the gap with frozen sell friction and remains ineligible until continuity resumes

decisionSchedule.decisionTime: first available Binance UTC daily open on or after Monday 00:00 UTC
decisionSchedule.featureCutoff: strictly before the decision open; all indicators use only daily bars whose close precedes the decision open
decisionSchedule.label: gross log return from the current weekly decision open to the next weekly decision open
decisionSchedule.holdingPeriod: one weekly decision interval unless a frozen missing-data forced exit occurs
decisionSchedule.embargo: one complete weekly interval between the endpoint of the newest training label and the prediction week

technicalSignals.crossSectionTransform: at every decision date, rank each available raw signal across eligible frozen-universe assets using average ranks for ties, then map the rank monotonically to [-0.5, 0.5]; no future-date standardization or pooled full-sample scaling

model.type: CTREND-inspired two-stage rolling cross-sectional forecast ensemble
model.firstStage: for each of the 28 ranked technical signals independently, estimate weekly cross-sectional return slopes using only eligible assets and realized labels available before the embargo; at each prediction date use the trailing 52 eligible weekly slopes to form that signal's current expected-return forecast
model.secondStage: using only pre-embargo training observations, fit an elastic-net regression of realized next-week gross returns on the 28 first-stage forecasts; mixing parameter alpha is fixed at 0.5
model.lambdaSelection: select lambda solely by corrected Akaike Information Criterion (AICc) on the training sample; no development-return grid search, Sharpe optimization, or final-holdout tuning
model.combination: retain only first-stage forecasts with strictly positive second-stage coefficient and take their equal-weight arithmetic mean as the final gross-return forecast; if none are retained, forecast no eligible trade
model.intercept: unpenalized where supported by the implementation
model.reason: preserve a low-capacity, interpretable aggregation of many weak technical signals rather than escalating directly to a tree/sequence model after Trial 1's failed candle-forecast robustness test

portfolio.selectionRule: rank eligible assets by final predicted next-week gross return; target at most the top three whose forecast exceeds the frozen 140 bps round-trip cost hurdle; unallocated capital remains cash
portfolio.turnoverRule: decisions occur weekly; an already-held asset that remains selected is resized toward 15% only at the weekly rebalance, while entries, exits and resizing pay frozen one-side implementation costs on traded notional

costModel.note: Use the same deliberately conservative TheOldTrader retail friction. Trial 4 may not assume maker savings unless a separately frozen execution experiment later validates an execution-policy successor; such a successor must be reported separately from this frozen evaluation.

developmentEvaluation.folds: expanding chronological 13-week test folds across 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31 with all training and AICc lambda selection restricted to pre-embargo information

comparators: same-universe 21-day momentum rank top-three weekly baseline with identical position caps and costs
same-universe equal-weight top-three-by-2022-liquidity static buy-and-hold at 45% total exposure
cross-sectional-v1 Trial 3 as a separately labeled frozen comparator only if Trial 3 has independently been evaluated without any Trial 4 information
frozen TheOldTrader v2 on BTC/ETH/SOL as a separately labeled directional benchmark where compatible historical data are available

required: final-holdout Sharpe positive and greater than the same-universe 21-day momentum weekly baseline
development walk-forward median candidate Sharpe positive
positive net return in a majority of development folds
candidate final-holdout net return greater than cash after all frozen costs
candidate total fee drag lower than frozen v2 benchmark when that benchmark is available on the same holdout
no single asset contributes more than 60% of positive realized portfolio profit
at least 20 completed portfolio position exits across development plus final holdout
no data-integrity exception, survivor substitution, post-formation membership change, or final-holdout-informed model change
promotionCriteria.note: Failure of any required criterion blocks promotion. Any change to universe membership/rule, signal definitions, 52-week window, elastic-net alpha, AICc lambda rule, positive-coefficient ensemble rule, cost gate, rebalance frequency, dates, or position sizing after any Trial 4 development or final result is observed requires a new numbered alpha trial.

multipleTesting.selectionAdjustment: report raw Sharpe with an explicit four-trial selection-bias warning; compute Deflated Sharpe Ratio once the set of observed candidate trials supplies the inputs needed for a meaningful estimate
